settings.question: Please note
settings.answer:
Please take your time to watch the video before you start taking your impressions.

Further information:

  • The impression material is not suitable for consumption.
  • Please do not swallow.
  • Avoid contact of the impression material with the eyes. In case of contact, rinse your eyes with clean water.
  • If possible, breathe only through your nose while taking impressions.
  • If you have loose teeth, consult your dentist first.
  • Use at your own risk.

settings.question: Contents of impression kit
settings.answer:
In your impression kit, you will find:

  • Impression trays
  • Yellow and white putties
  • Double syringe with mixing tips

The material is enough for two attempts per jaw. If you ordered veneers for the upper or lower teeth, you'll have material for two attempts in your kit. If you ordered veneers for both the upper and lower teeth, there should be enough material for four attempts.
